$sources: NBCC 2020 4.1.8 (earthquake load and effects): 4.1.8.4 site properties and the design spectral acceleration S(T), 4.1.8.6 irregularities, 4.1.8.9 SFRS (Rd, Ro, height limits), 4.1.8.11 equivalent static force procedure, 4.1.8.12 dynamic analysis, 4.1.8.13 deflections and drift limits

generatorSystems.$comment: SAEngine practice: the New Building generator's steel systems, least ductile first (conventional construction, Type LD, Type MD, Type D of Table 4.1.8.9); the first the category and the height permit is taken

SA.description: Site class A: hard rock (vs30 above 1500 m/s)

SC.description: Site class C: very dense soil and soft rock (vs30 360-760 m/s)

SD.description: Site class D: stiff soil (vs30 180-360 m/s)

SE.description: Site class E: soft soil (vs30 below 180 m/s)

SF.description: Site class F: soils needing a site-specific evaluation (4.1.8.4(4))

steelImf.name: Steel: moderately ductile moment-resisting frames (Type MD)

steelScbf.name: Steel: moderately ductile concentrically braced frames (Type MD)
steelScbf.row: Steel, moderately ductile concentrically braced frames

steelOcbf.name: Steel: limited-ductility concentrically braced frames (Type LD)

steelEbfMoment.name: Steel: ductile eccentrically braced frames (moment-resisting beam-column connections)
steelEbfMoment.note: NBCC has one eccentrically braced frame row; both SAEngine ids take it.

steelBrbfMoment.name: Steel: ductile buckling-restrained braced frames (moment-resisting beam-column connections)
steelBrbfMoment.note: NBCC has one buckling-restrained braced frame row; both SAEngine ids take it.

steelNotDetailed.name: Steel: conventional construction (moment-resisting or braced frames)

rcSpecialWallFrame.name: Concrete: ductile shear walls (with a gravity frame)

rcOrdinaryWallFrame.name: Concrete: moderately ductile shear walls (with a gravity frame)

rcDualSpecial.name: Concrete: ductile shear walls with ductile moment-resisting frames (taken as the walls' row)
rcDualSpecial.note: NBCC has no dual system row: the walls' Rd and Ro (the lesser, on the safe side; SAEngine practice).

masonryOrdinaryReinforcedFrame.name: Masonry: limited-ductility shear walls (with a gravity frame)

masonryOrdinaryPlainFrame.name: Masonry: unreinforced masonry (with a gravity frame)

siteSpecificStudy.warning: Site class {classes}: {code} {clause} requires a site-specific evaluation. Until one is made, the spectrum uses the values entered for the site (class {used}) and the category of the height limits is read for {assumed}: an assumption, not a value of the code.

inPlaneDiscontinuity.label: In-plane discontinuity in vertical lateral-force-resisting element (Type 4)

clauses.strength: the storey shear strength of the columns and walls (the parent's ACI 318-19 form, SAEngine practice)

sources.designSpectrum: NBCC 2020 4.1.8.4(7): S(T) from the site's 5 % damped Sa(T, X) at 0.2, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 5.0 and 10.0 s, linear between, S(0.2) the larger of Sa(0.2) and Sa(0.5); held at S(10) beyond 10 s (SAEngine: on the safe side). The bands of S(0.2) (0.2, 0.35, 0.75) are the ranges of Table 4.1.8.9 (with IE: see designCategories). 4.1.8.11(2): V = S(Ta) Mv IE W / (Rd Ro), at least S(2.0) Mv IE W / (Rd Ro) (moment-resisting frames, braced frames, other) or S(4.0) Mv IE W / (Rd Ro) (walls, coupled walls, wall-frames); for Rd >= 1.5 at most max(2/3 S(0.2), S(0.5)) IE W / (Rd Ro). Mv: no table entered (Mv = 1; NBCC Table 4.1.8.11 to be entered, see VERIFY.md); J not applied (J = 1, on the safe side)
sources.siteClasses: NBCC 2020 Table 4.1.8.4-A, site classes A-F by vs30 (ids with SAEngine's S prefix)
sources.systems: NBCC 2020 Table 4.1.8.9: Rd, Ro (R = Rd Ro, Cd = Rd Ro for the deflections of 4.1.8.13(2), Ω0 = Ro: SAEngine practice) and the height limits [m] read for the ranges of IE S(0.2): B below 0.35 (the 0.2-0.35 column), C 0.35-0.75, D above 0.75 (see VERIFY.md); NL empty, NP 0
sources.periodCoefficients: NBCC 2020 4.1.8.11(3): Ta = 0.085 hn^0.75 steel and 0.075 hn^0.75 concrete moment frames, 0.025 hn braced frames, 0.05 hn^0.75 shear walls and other structures
sources.designCategories: SAEngine's category letters B, C, D for the ranges of IE S(0.2) of Table 4.1.8.9 (below 0.35, 0.35-0.75, above 0.75); the High and Post-disaster categories one range up (IE 1.3 and 1.5 on S(0.2): SAEngine practice, on the safe side)
sources.requiredDetailing: NBCC 2020 has no detailing level by category: the system's Rd and its height limits govern (4.1.8.9)
sources.allowableDrift: NBCC 2020 4.1.8.13(3): 0.01 hs post-disaster, 0.02 hs High importance, 0.025 hs others
sources.driftAmplification: NBCC 2020 4.1.8.13(2): the deflections of the elastic analysis × Rd Ro / IE
sources.lateralForce: NBCC 2020 4.1.8.11(7): Ft = 0.07 Ta V at most 0.25 V, 0 for Ta <= 0.7 s; Fx = (V - Ft) Wx hx / Σ Wi hi
sources.torsionIrregular: NBCC 2020 4.1.8.11(10) and Table 4.1.8.6 Type 7: torsional sensitivity B = δmax / δave > 1.7 (with the ± 0.10 Dn forces)
sources.torsionAmplificationMax: NBCC 2020 has no amplification of the accidental torsion: 1.0
sources.minimumScale: NBCC 2020 4.1.8.12(8): Vd at least 80 % of V for regular structures (100 % for irregular ones: SAEngine applies 80 %, raise it under Code Values for an irregular structure)
sources.liveShare: NBCC 2020 4.1.8.2 (W): the dead load, 25 % of the design snow load, 60 % of the storage load and the full contents of tanks; SAEngine takes live loads above 4.8 kPa as storage (SAEngine practice)
sources.pgaFactor: SAEngine's mapping of S(0.2) to the peak ground acceleration (0.4 S(0.2)), for the checks that ask for it
sources.verticalFactor: NBCC 2020 has no vertical component in the combinations: 0
sources.stability: NBCC 2020 4.1.8.3(8): sway effects of the interaction of the gravity loads with the deformed structure; θ = P dr / (V h) with dr = Rd Ro de, P-delta not needed below 0.10 (SAEngine practice)
sources.separation: NBCC 2020 4.1.8.14(2): the sum of the two buildings' deflections
sources.irregularities: NBCC 2020 Table 4.1.8.6 Types 1-8 (re-entrant corners and diaphragm openings are no NBCC types; the extreme types are not separate)
